svg.title: Projection rule for a planar optical fold
svg.desc: An ideal collimated beam has width W before and after reflection. Its footprint on a splitter tilted by theta is W footprint equals W divided by cosine theta. A physical clear length A on that splitter accepts C fold equals A cosine theta. At the upper hit point the reflection-law vectors are drawn: incident direction d, surface normal n, reflected direction d r, the incidence angle theta between minus d and n, and the deviation delta equals one hundred eighty degrees minus two theta.
svg.text: A planar fold redirects a beam; it does not shrink its normal cross-section

g.aria-label: cos θ converts between a dimension on the tilted surface and a dimension normal to the chief ray
g.data-original-text: <text x="400" y="44" text-anchor="middle" class="subtitle">cos θ converts between a dimension on the tilted surface and a dimension normal to the chief ray</text>
g.title: cos θ converts between a dimension on the tilted surface and a dimension normal to the chief ray

svg.text: measured normal to the incident chief ray

g.data-original-text: <text x="440" y="228" text-anchor="middle" transform="rotate(45 440 228)" class="strong">W<tspan dy="3" font-size="9">footprint</tspan><tspan dy="-3"> = W / |cos θ|</tspan></text>
g.title: Wfootprint = W / |cos θ|

g.aria-label: Cfold = A |cos θ| — projected clear width
g.data-original-text: <text x="615" y="263" text-anchor="middle" class="formula">C<tspan dy="3" font-size="10">fold</tspan><tspan dy="-3"> = A |cos θ| — projected clear width</tspan></text>
g.title: Cfold = A |cos θ| — projected clear width

svg.text: Use A only when it was measured
